instruction: Please configure GIMP to use "Symbolic" icons instead of the default colored icons in the toolbox.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because changing icon styles in GIMP requires preference navigation and the visual verification of symbolic vs colored icons cannot be reliably automated. Maintains the pattern of infeasible GIMP UI customization tasks.
